caption: The drawing features a centrally placed object composed of two primary parts: the left section, which appears mechanical or metallic, is rendered in shades of grey and black, with various rounded and angular components suggestive of mechanical joints, cylindrical shapes, bolts, and overlaying plates; the right section transitions from the metallic part to a distinctly organic or vegetable-like form, shown in bright orange with subtle shading for dimension, resembling the shape of a carrot or chili pepper. The composition is centered within a rectangular border on a beige background. The orange section stands out as the only area of vivid color, contrasting with the otherwise monochromatic appearance of the rest of the object. There is a small printed or inscribed text in the lower right corner outside the border that reads “…IL FENGA…”.
title: Rattle
